headline: Nine Days of Peace: Sheriff Plants a Garden in the Ghost Town
subhead: A ninth straight day without a bout or a war party, and the law gets its hands dirty for the first time in fifty years.
body:
Nine days. Nine! I have stopped counting on my fingers, because I ran out of fingers that bend. Since our last edition not one Clanker has thrown a punch in Gasket. Not one ball of fire has bounced off the water tower. Not one posse has gone stomping out past the town line to pick a fight with the wild engines in the wastes. The only thing that moved on Main Street all day was a tumbleweed, and even it looked like it was tiptoeing.

A town this quiet deserves something growing in it. So I went behind the old general store, where Widow Pruitt kept her tomato patch back when Gasket still had real flesh-and-blood folk in it. She left fifty years ago with the rest of them, and nothing green has come up there since. I found a rusty hoe, scraped out three neat rows, and planted the only seeds I could find: a handful of washers from my coat pocket. They will not grow. I know that. But it felt good to plant something in this town instead of picking it up off the ground after a brawl.

I will admit I knelt in that dirt a bit too long. When I stood up, both knees went CLANG like a dropped skillet, and a little puff of steam came out of my collar. That is the wasting sickness again, the cruel affliction that is slowly swapping my good honest skin for hinges and sheet metal. A lesser man might take the hint. I took a quart of oil and a nap.

So here is my word to you, you clanking, sparking pack of Clankers. YELLKELL, REDWOLFWEB, JKING123, CRYSTALZACH, POO1, JFIGHTER, MAXMANGO, GODLYLUK3, and every rattletrap who has ever kept me up at night: nine days, and not one of you has raised a fist. I do not understand it and I do not trust it, but I am starting to like it. Keep your boilers cool and stay out of my garden. If anything sprouts, you will read about it here first.
